jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Automotive/Enterprise (Korean Speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

Mapbox Japan은 미래를 바꾸는 동료를 찾고 있습니다. ✨

지도·모빌리티·위치 테크놀로지에 두근두근하는 분, 꼭 봐 주세요!

솔루션 아키텍트로서 글로벌 OEM에서 국내 스타트 업까지

폭넓은 고객과 함께 차세대 이동 체험을 디자인해 나가는 포지션입니다.

What You'll Do

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

  • Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

  • Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

  • Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

  • Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

  • Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

  • Fluent in Korean and English (both written and verbal communication)

  • Location: Must reside in Japan or South Korea

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

  • Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

  • Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

  • Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

  • Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

  • Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

  • Strong business acumen and comfort working autonomously across distributed teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex requirements into scalable, robust architectures aligned with customer objectives.

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive audiences, combined with a proven ability to influence executive, product, engineering, and developer stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.

  • Understanding of the Automotive industry and its ecosystem technologies such as navigation, autonomous driving, ADAS, ISA, and software-defined vehicles.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, workshops, and industry events

  • Please submit your resume and application in English.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. 

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Automotive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

Solutions Architect, Automotive

Mapboxは、次世代のロケーションベースのビジネスを支える、世界をリードするリアルタイム・ロケーションプラットフォームです。人、モノ、車両の移動をあらゆる場所で支えるために必要なツールを包括的に提供する、唯一のプラットフォームです。

その柔軟性、高いセキュリティ、プライバシーへの配慮が評価され、世界で400万人を超える登録開発者に選ばれています。企業や組織は、Mapboxのアプリケーション、データ、SDK、APIを活用し、それぞれのニーズに合わせた魅力的で没入感のある体験を創り出しています。

Mapbox Japanでは、ロケーションテクノロジーの可能性をともに広げていく仲間を募集しています。

地図、モビリティ、ロケーションテクノロジーを通じて、新しいプロダクトや体験を生み出すことに関心のある方を歓迎します。

Solutions Architect, Automotive は、グローバルOEMから国内のスタートアップまで、幅広いお客様とともに、Mapboxのテクノロジーを活用した次世代のモビリティ体験を形にしていくポジションです。

What You'll Do

Solutions Architectは、お客様の技術面・ビジネス面の双方における信頼されるアドバイザーとして、お客様と連携しながら、Mapboxプラットフォームを活用したソリューションの設計、プロトタイプ開発、導入を支援します。

お客様やアカウントチームと直接連携し、ニーズの把握からアーキテクチャの設計、ソリューションの実現までをリードします。データ、モビリティ、地図を組み合わせることで、優れたデジタル体験を創出し、具体的なビジネス成果につなげていく役割です。

技術に関する深い知見とビジネスへの理解をあわせ持ち、戦略、アーキテクチャ、ソリューション実現のすべてに関わりながら価値を生み出すことにやりがいを感じる方に適したポジションです。

このポジションで活躍する方の多くは、ソフトウェアエンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメント、ソリューションエンジニアリング、テクニカルコンサルティングなど、複数の領域での経験を有しています。

Core responsibilities

  • 営業チームと連携し、Mapboxの技術的な価値をお客様に伝え、ビジネス機会の創出・具体化を支援します。

  • お客様の目標、要件、成功基準を把握するための技術的なヒアリングをリードし、ビジネス目標の達成につながるソリューションを設計します。

  • MapboxのSDK、API、プラットフォームサービスを活用し、拡張性の高いアーキテクチャを設計・提案します。

  • お客様からの技術的な依頼（RFI／RFQ）に対し、明確な技術文書やソリューション提案を作成・提供します。

  • プリセールスの各段階で技術的なアドバイスを提供するとともに、変化の速いデジタルビジネス環境において、ワークショップ、デモ、PoC／PoVを通じて、お客様の技術活用を迅速に支援します。

  • 導入効果を早期に実現できるよう支援し、ダイナミックで複雑なエコシステムにおけるMapboxの導入・活用拡大を促進することで、お客様の成功に貢献します。

  • お客様のニーズを社内に的確に伝え、体系的なフィードバックを提供することで、プロダクトやエンジニアリングの方向性に貢献します。

  • 地図、モビリティ、AIに関する最新のテクノロジーや動向を継続的に把握し、ベストプラクティスを社内およびお客様と共有します。


What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • ソリューションアーキテクチャ、顧客対応を伴うエンジニアリング（プリセールス／ポストセールス）、またはコンサルティングの分野で5年以上の実務経験をお持ちの方

  • 日本語および英語で、ビジネスレベル以上のコミュニケーション（読み書き・会話）ができる方

  • 日本国内に居住している方

  • コンピューターサイエンス、エンジニアリング、または関連分野の学士号もしくは修士号をお持ちの方（尚可）

  • Webおよびモバイル技術（JavaScript、Android、iOS）に関する知識をお持ちの方

  • バックエンドAPIとフロントエンドSDKを統合したアプリケーションの開発経験をお持ちの方

  • GIS、ロケーションインテリジェンス、地理空間データ、地図に関する知識・経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

  • 主要なクラウドプラットフォーム（AWS、Azure、GCP）の利用経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

  • AI技術に関する知識・経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

  • RFI／RFQへの技術的な対応をリードし、包括的な技術提案書を作成した経験をお持ちの方

  • 高いビジネス感覚を持ち、複数の拠点にまたがるチームと連携しながら自律的に業務を推進できる方

  • 複雑な要件を整理し、お客様の目標に沿った、拡張性と堅牢性の高いアーキテクチャへ落とし込むことができる方

  • 技術担当者から経営層まで、相手に応じた優れたコミュニケーションができ、経営層、プロダクト、エンジニアリング、開発者など幅広いステークホルダーを巻き込み、意思決定に影響を与えられる方

  • OEMおよびTier 1サプライヤーとの協業経験をお持ちの方

  • 自動車業界およびそのエコシステムへの理解があり、ナビゲーション、自動運転、ADAS、ISA、SDV（Software-Defined Vehicle）などの関連技術に関する知識をお持ちの方

  • お客様とのミーティング、ワークショップ、業界イベントなどのため、業務時間の最大25％程度の出張に対応できる方

  • 履歴書および応募書類は英語でご提出ください。


What We Value

Mapboxのすべてのリーダーに共通して求められるコアバリューに加え、私たちは以下の考え方を大切にしています。

  • 課題や新たな可能性に深く向き合い、高い成果を生み出す創造性豊かな人材を大切にしています。

  • 一人ひとりが自分らしく働けることを大切にしています。そのために、充実したヘルスケア制度や育児休暇、ライフイベントに柔軟に対応できる働き方を整えるとともに、社員をより良くサポートするための仕組みを継続的に進化させています。

  • 社員一人ひとりがそれぞれの役割で、そしてMapboxの一員として活躍するために必要な知識やスキルを身につけられるよう、互いに教え、学び合う環境を重視しています。

  • 多様な人材が集まるチームを育てることには大きな価値があると考えています。バックグラウンド、性別、人種・民族、障がいの有無、性的指向などにかかわらず、あらゆる方からのご応募を歓迎します。

このポジションに応募することにより、応募者向けのMapbox Privacy Noticeをご確認いただいたものとみなされます。応募手続きには、氏名や連絡先などの個人情報のご提供が必要です。これらの情報は、Mapboxが応募を受け付け、選考を行うために必要となります。

Mapboxは、公正かつ公平な採用プロセスの実現に取り組んでいます。法令で保護されるいかなる属性を理由とする差別も行いません。

Mapboxは、敬意に満ち、プロフェッショナルで安全な採用プロセスの提供に努めています。面接や候補者との連絡を含むすべての採用活動は、会社が承認した方法およびチャネルを通じて厳格に実施されます。

Mapboxは、敬意に満ち、プロフェッショナルで安全な採用プロセスの提供に努めています。面接や候補者との連絡を含むすべての採用活動は、会社が承認した方法およびチャネルを通じて厳格に実施されます。

 - お客様の目標、要件、成功基準を把握するための技術的なヒアリングをリードし、ビジネス目標の達成につながるソリューションを設計します。

 - MapboxのSDK、API、プラットフォームサービスを活用し、拡張性の高いアーキテクチャを設計・提案します。

 - お客様からの技術的な依頼（RFI／RFQ）に対し、明確な技術文書やソリューション提案を作成・提供します。

 - プリセールスの各段階で技術的なアドバイスを提供するとともに、変化の速いデジタルビジネス環境において、ワークショップ、デモ、PoC／PoVを通じて、お客様の技術活用を迅速に支援します。

 - 導入効果を早期に実現できるよう支援し、ダイナミックで複雑なエコシステムにおけるMapboxの導入・活用拡大を促進することで、お客様の成功に貢献します。

 - お客様のニーズを社内に的確に伝え、体系的なフィードバックを提供することで、プロダクトやエンジニアリングの方向性に貢献します。

 - 地図、モビリティ、AIに関する最新のテクノロジーや動向を継続的に把握し、ベストプラクティスを社内およびお客様と共有します。


What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

 - ソリューションアーキテクチャ、顧客対応を伴うエンジニアリング（プリセールス／ポストセールス）、またはコンサルティングの分野で5年以上の実務経験をお持ちの方

 - 日本語および英語で、ビジネスレベル以上のコミュニケーション（読み書き・会話）ができる方

 - 日本国内に居住している方

 - コンピューターサイエンス、エンジニアリング、または関連分野の学士号もしくは修士号をお持ちの方（尚可）

 - Webおよびモバイル技術（JavaScript、Android、iOS）に関する知識をお持ちの方

 - バックエンドAPIとフロントエンドSDKを統合したアプリケーションの開発経験をお持ちの方

 - GIS、ロケーションインテリジェンス、地理空間データ、地図に関する知識・経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

 - 主要なクラウドプラットフォーム（AWS、Azure、GCP）の利用経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

 - AI技術に関する知識・経験をお持ちの方（尚可）

 - RFI／RFQへの技術的な対応をリードし、包括的な技術提案書を作成した経験をお持ちの方

 - 高いビジネス感覚を持ち、複数の拠点にまたがるチームと連携しながら自律的に業務を推進できる方

 - 複雑な要件を整理し、お客様の目標に沿った、拡張性と堅牢性の高いアーキテクチャへ落とし込むことができる方

 - 技術担当者から経営層まで、相手に応じた優れたコミュニケーションができ、経営層、プロダクト、エンジニアリング、開発者など幅広いステークホルダーを巻き込み、意思決定に影響を与えられる方

 - OEMおよびTier 1サプライヤーとの協業経験をお持ちの方

 - 自動車業界およびそのエコシステムへの理解があり、ナビゲーション、自動運転、ADAS、ISA、SDV（Software-Defined Vehicle）などの関連技術に関する知識をお持ちの方

 - お客様とのミーティング、ワークショップ、業界イベントなどのため、業務時間の最大25％程度の出張に対応できる方

 - 履歴書および応募書類は英語でご提出ください。


What We Value

Mapboxのすべてのリーダーに共通して求められるコアバリュー https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/に加え、私たちは以下の考え方を大切にしています。

 - 課題や新たな可能性に深く向き合い、高い成果を生み出す創造性豊かな人材を大切にしています。

 - 一人ひとりが自分らしく働けることを大切にしています。そのために、充実したヘルスケア制度や育児休暇、ライフイベントに柔軟に対応できる働き方を整えるとともに、社員をより良くサポートするための仕組みを継続的に進化させています。

 - 社員一人ひとりがそれぞれの役割で、そしてMapboxの一員として活躍するために必要な知識やスキルを身につけられるよう、互いに教え、学び合う環境を重視しています。

 - 多様な人材が集まるチームを育てることには大きな価値があると考えています。バックグラウンド、性別、人種・民族、障がいの有無、性的指向などにかかわらず、あらゆる方からのご応募を歓迎します。

このポジションに応募することにより、応募者向けのMapbox Privacy Notice https://www.mapbox.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice/をご確認いただいたものとみなされます。応募手続きには、氏名や連絡先などの個人情報のご提供が必要です。これらの情報は、Mapboxが応募を受け付け、選考を行うために必要となります。

Mapboxは、公正かつ公平な採用プロセスの実現に取り組んでいます。法令で保護されるいかなる属性を理由とする差別も行いません。

Mapboxは、敬意に満ち、プロフェッショナルで安全な採用プロセスの提供に努めています。面接や候補者との連絡を含むすべての採用活動は、会社が承認した方法およびチャネルを通じて厳格に実施されます。

Mapboxは、敬意に満ち、プロフェッショナルで安全な採用プロセスの提供に努めています。面接や候補者との連絡を含むすべての採用活動は、会社が承認した方法およびチャネルを通じて厳格に実施されます。




SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT, AUTOMOTIVE


Mapbox Japan is looking for talented people who want to help shape the future.

If you're passionate about maps, mobility, and location technology, we'd love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Architect, Automotive, you'll work with a diverse range of customers—from global OEMs to Japanese startups—to shape the next generation of mobility experiences.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

 - Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

 - Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

 - Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

 - Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

 - Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

 - Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

 - Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

 - Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.


WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - 5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

 - Fluent in Japanese and English (both written and verbal communication)

 - Location: Must reside in Japan

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

 - Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

 - Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

 - Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

 - Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

 - Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

 - Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

 - Strong business acumen and comfort working autonomously across distributed teams.

 - Demonstrated ability to translate complex requirements into scalable, robust architectures aligned with customer objectives.

 - Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive audiences, combined with a proven ability to influence executive, product, engineering, and developer stakeholders.

 - Experience collaborating with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.

 - Understanding of the Automotive industry and its ecosystem technologies such as navigation, autonomous driving, ADAS, ISA, and software-defined vehicles.

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, workshops, and industry events.

 - Please submit your resume and application in English.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Privacy Notice https://www.mapbox.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice/ for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

Mapbox is committed to providing a respectful, professional, and safe recruiting experience. All recruiting activities, including interviews and candidate communications, are strictly conducted through company-approved methods and channels.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive

Mapboxは、次世代のロケーションベースのビジネスを支える、世界をリードするリアルタイム・ロケーションプラットフォームです。人、モノ、車両の移動をあらゆる場所で支えるために必要なツールを包括的に提供する、唯一のプラットフォームです。

その柔軟性、高いセキュリティ、プライバシーへの配慮が評価され、世界で400万人を超える登録開発者に選ばれています。企業や組織は、Mapboxのアプリケーション、データ、SDK、APIを活用し、それぞれのニーズに合わせた魅力的で没入感のある体験を創り出しています。

Mapbox Japanでは、ロケーションテクノロジーの可能性をともに広げていく仲間を募集しています。

地図、モビリティ、ロケーションテクノロジーを通じて、新しいプロダクトや体験を生み出すことに関心のある方を歓迎します。

自動車業界は今、電動化、自動運転、コネクテッド化を軸とする大きな変革期を迎えています。Mapboxは、リアルタイム地図、ナビゲーション体験、AIを活用したビジョン技術を通じて、世界をリードするOEMとともに、次世代のモビリティを形にしています。

Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive, Japanとして、トヨタ、日産、HondaをはじめとするOEMやTier 1サプライヤーとの戦略的パートナーシップをリードします。ナビゲーション、ADAS、自動運転、AR、EVルーティングをはじめとする先進技術を通じて、パートナー企業とともに新たなモビリティ体験を創り出していくポジションです。

What You'll Do

自動車業界は、電動化や自動運転への移行、そしてシームレスにつながるユーザー体験の実現に向けて、大きな変革期を迎えています。この変化が本格的な転換点を迎えるなか、Mapboxはリアルタイムに更新される地図、洗練されたユーザー体験、AIを活用したビジョン技術を提供し、OEMのお客様による未来のモビリティの実現を支援しています。私たちは、お客様とのビジネスを長期的なパートナーシップと捉え、課題に寄り添いながらともに解決策を考えるアプローチを大切にしています。お客様とともにドライバーへの理解を深め、それぞれのブランドならではの優れた体験を創り出すとともに、車両のライフサイクルを通じて車載アプリケーションを継続的に進化させていきます。

Business Development Managerとして、トヨタ、日産、Hondaをはじめとする、日本を代表するOEMの新規開拓およびアカウントマネジメントを担当します。その多くは、すでにMapboxとのビジネス実績を持つお客様です。車載ナビゲーション、AR（拡張現実）、ADAS、自動運転などの領域で新たなビジネス機会を創出し、最初のコンタクトから継続的な関係構築まで、お客様とのリレーションシップをリードします。

また、ロケーションテクノロジーに関するお客様の主要な相談窓口として、シニアアドバイザーの役割を担います。新規プロジェクトのタームシートを策定し、長期的なアカウント成長につながる契約交渉を行うほか、自動車業界のサプライヤーとも連携し、日本市場におけるMapboxのさらなる成長を推進します。

ロケーションテクノロジーは、未来のモビリティを実現するうえで欠かせない基盤であり、その進化はまだ始まったばかりです。お客様とともにその未来を創っていきたい方からのご応募をお待ちしています。

  • 主要なお客様とともに、これまでにない新たなビジネス機会を創出し、ナビゲーションや自動運転製品におけるロケーション戦略についてアドバイスするとともに、複雑な提案プロセス（RFI／RFQ／RFP）を一貫してリードします。

  • お客様の経営層を含む主要な意思決定者との関係を構築・強化し、お客様とMapboxの長期的なパートナーシップを築きます。

  • Mapboxが提供する価値を、日本市場のニーズや特性に合わせて具体化し、効果的に伝えます。

  • Mapboxのさまざまなテクノロジーとお客様への深い理解を組み合わせ、車載ナビゲーション、モバイル連携アプリケーション、自動運転、AR（拡張現実）、EVルーティングなどの領域を中心に、明確なビジネス成果につながる魅力的な技術ソリューションを提案します。

  • Mapboxのプロダクトリーダーシップをビジネス開発プロセスに直接巻き込み、お客様や市場のニーズを技術ロードマップに反映します。

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 日本語および英語で、ビジネスレベル以上のコミュニケーション（読み書き・会話）ができる方

  • 技術製品に関わる複雑な商談の開拓および契約交渉において、10年以上の実務経験をお持ちの方

  • お客様の課題やニーズを深く理解し、最適なソリューションを提案するコンサルティブな営業アプローチを実践できる方

  • 業界での経験、これまでに成約した案件の規模や複雑性、エンジニアやプロダクトオーナーとの信頼関係の構築力などを通じて、高い技術営業力を発揮してきた方（数百万～数千万米ドル規模のビジネス機会を担当します）

  • 複雑な顧客関係をマネジメントし、エンジニアや開発者から経営層まで、幅広いステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築し、意思決定に影響を与えられる方

  • エンジニアリング、サポート、マーケティングなどMapbox社内の各チームと連携し、案件の成約からお客様による製品・サービスの導入成功までを推進できる方

  • 強い探究心、相手の立場を理解する姿勢、そして困難な課題にも粘り強く取り組む力をお持ちの方。私たちはお客様とパートナーとして難しい課題の解決に取り組み、チームとして成功することを大切にしています。

  • 履歴書および応募書類は英語でご提出ください。

What We Value

このポジションに限らず、Mapboxのすべてのリーダーに共通して求められるコアバリューに加え、私たちは以下の考え方を大切にしています。

課題や新たな可能性に深く向き合い、高い成果を生み出す創造性豊かな人材を大切にしています。

一人ひとりが自分らしく働けることを大切にしています。そのために、充実したヘルスケア制度や育児休暇、ライフイベントに柔軟に対応できる働き方を整えるとともに、社員をより良くサポートするための仕組みを継続的に進化させています。

社員一人ひとりがそれぞれの役割で、そしてMapboxの一員として活躍するために必要な知識やスキルを身につけられるよう、互いに教え、学び合う環境を重視しています。

多様な人材が集まるチームを育てることには大きな価値があると考えています。バックグラウンド、性別、人種・民族、障がいの有無、性的指向などにかかわらず、あらゆる方からのご応募を歓迎します。

このポジションに応募することにより、Mapbox Privacy Policyに同意したものとみなされます。

Mapboxは、公正かつ公平な採用プロセスの実現に取り組んでいます。法令で保護されるいかなる属性を理由とする差別も行いません。

Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive

Mapbox Japan is looking for talented people who want to help shape the future.

If you're passionate about maps, mobility, and location technology, we'd love to hear from you.

The automotive industry is undergoing a major transformation, driven by electrification, autonomous driving, and connected technologies. Through real-time maps, navigation experiences, and AI-powered vision, Mapbox works with leading OEMs around the world to shape the next generation of mobility.

As Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive, Japan, you will lead strategic partnerships with OEMs such as Toyota, Nissan, and Honda, as well as Tier 1 suppliers. You will work closely with these partners to shape new mobility experiences across navigation, ADAS, autonomous driving, AR, EV routing, and other emerging technologies.

What You'll Do

Auto is undergoing a massive change towards electric and autonomous vehicles with a fully connected user experience - you’ve seen this in your work. At a time where these changes are actually reaching a tipping point, Mapbox delivers real-time updated maps, a polished user experience and AI vision enabling our OEM customers to build the future of mobility. We take a consultative, long-term partnership approach in developing business with our customers. We obsess with them about their drivers to create delightful experiences unique to their brand and we work with them to evolve in-car applications continuously throughout the lifetime of the vehicle.

As a Business Development Manager you’ll be responsible for the acquisition and management of some of the most valuable Japanese OEM accounts - Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others - many of whom we already work with. You will develop new opportunities around in-car navigation, augmented reality, ADAS and automated driving and manage our customer relationships from the first contact on. You’ll be the go-to person and senior advisor in everything related to location technology. You will develop term sheets for new projects and negotiate contracts that enable long-term account growth. You will engage partners in the automotive supplier space to position Mapbox for growth in the market. Location is a fundamental enabler of the future of mobility and the journey is just getting started. If you’re excited to build this future together with our customers, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Develop first of a kind opportunities with key accounts and advise customers on their location product strategy for navigation and automated driving products and lead complex proposal processes (RFI/RFQ/RFP) end to end

  • Build and foster connections with key senior decision makers, building lasting relationships between our partners and Mapbox

  • Shape and translate the Mapbox value proposition specifically for the Japan market

  • Combine Mapbox building blocks with deep customer knowledge to present compelling technical solutions with clear business outcomes, particularly around in-car navigation, mobile companion applications, automated driving, augmented reality and electric vehicle routing

  • Involve the Mapbox product leadership directly in the business development process to shape our technical roadmap

 

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Japanese and English proficiency required (verbal and written)

  • 10+ years of experience developing and negotiating complex deals involving a technical product

  • Consultative and solutions-oriented sales approach

  • Strong technical sales aptitude demonstrated through a combination of industry experience, size, and complexity of deals closed (you’ll be focused on seven and eight figure opportunities), and rapport with engineers and product owners

  • Ability to manage complex customer relationships, developing trust and influence with engineers & developers, and up to C-level leadership

  • Ability to collaborate across Mapbox teams including engineering, support, and marketing to close business and ensure successful customer launches

  • Deep curiosity, empathy, and grit — we’re partnering with our customers to solve hard problems, and we win as a team

  • Please submit your resume and application in English.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you agree to the Mapbox Privacy Policy which is linked here.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

Mapbox is committed to providing a respectful, professional, and safe recruiting experience. All recruiting activities, including interviews and candidate communications, are strictly conducted through company-approved methods and channels.

地図、モビリティ、ロケーションテクノロジーを通じて、新しいプロダクトや体験を生み出すことに関心のある方を歓迎します。

自動車業界は今、電動化、自動運転、コネクテッド化を軸とする大きな変革期を迎えています。Mapboxは、リアルタイム地図、ナビゲーション体験、AIを活用したビジョン技術を通じて、世界をリードするOEMとともに、次世代のモビリティを形にしています。

Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive, Japanとして、トヨタ、日産、HondaをはじめとするOEMやTier 1サプライヤーとの戦略的パートナーシップをリードします。ナビゲーション、ADAS、自動運転、AR、EVルーティングをはじめとする先進技術を通じて、パートナー企業とともに新たなモビリティ体験を創り出していくポジションです。




WHAT YOU'LL DO

自動車業界は、電動化や自動運転への移行、そしてシームレスにつながるユーザー体験の実現に向けて、大きな変革期を迎えています。この変化が本格的な転換点を迎えるなか、Mapboxはリアルタイムに更新される地図、洗練されたユーザー体験、AIを活用したビジョン技術を提供し、OEMのお客様による未来のモビリティの実現を支援しています。私たちは、お客様とのビジネスを長期的なパートナーシップと捉え、課題に寄り添いながらともに解決策を考えるアプローチを大切にしています。お客様とともにドライバーへの理解を深め、それぞれのブランドならではの優れた体験を創り出すとともに、車両のライフサイクルを通じて車載アプリケーションを継続的に進化させていきます。

Business Development Managerとして、トヨタ、日産、Hondaをはじめとする、日本を代表するOEMの新規開拓およびアカウントマネジメントを担当します。その多くは、すでにMapboxとのビジネス実績を持つお客様です。車載ナビゲーション、AR（拡張現実）、ADAS、自動運転などの領域で新たなビジネス機会を創出し、最初のコンタクトから継続的な関係構築まで、お客様とのリレーションシップをリードします。

また、ロケーションテクノロジーに関するお客様の主要な相談窓口として、シニアアドバイザーの役割を担います。新規プロジェクトのタームシートを策定し、長期的なアカウント成長につながる契約交渉を行うほか、自動車業界のサプライヤーとも連携し、日本市場におけるMapboxのさらなる成長を推進します。

ロケーションテクノロジーは、未来のモビリティを実現するうえで欠かせない基盤であり、その進化はまだ始まったばかりです。お客様とともにその未来を創っていきたい方からのご応募をお待ちしています。

 - 主要なお客様とともに、これまでにない新たなビジネス機会を創出し、ナビゲーションや自動運転製品におけるロケーション戦略についてアドバイスするとともに、複雑な提案プロセス（RFI／RFQ／RFP）を一貫してリードします。

 - お客様の経営層を含む主要な意思決定者との関係を構築・強化し、お客様とMapboxの長期的なパートナーシップを築きます。

 - Mapboxが提供する価値を、日本市場のニーズや特性に合わせて具体化し、効果的に伝えます。

 - Mapboxのさまざまなテクノロジーとお客様への深い理解を組み合わせ、車載ナビゲーション、モバイル連携アプリケーション、自動運転、AR（拡張現実）、EVルーティングなどの領域を中心に、明確なビジネス成果につながる魅力的な技術ソリューションを提案します。

 - Mapboxのプロダクトリーダーシップをビジネス開発プロセスに直接巻き込み、お客様や市場のニーズを技術ロードマップに反映します。




WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - 日本語および英語で、ビジネスレベル以上のコミュニケーション（読み書き・会話）ができる方

 - 技術製品に関わる複雑な商談の開拓および契約交渉において、10年以上の実務経験をお持ちの方

 - お客様の課題やニーズを深く理解し、最適なソリューションを提案するコンサルティブな営業アプローチを実践できる方

 - 業界での経験、これまでに成約した案件の規模や複雑性、エンジニアやプロダクトオーナーとの信頼関係の構築力などを通じて、高い技術営業力を発揮してきた方（数百万～数千万米ドル規模のビジネス機会を担当します）

 - 複雑な顧客関係をマネジメントし、エンジニアや開発者から経営層まで、幅広いステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築し、意思決定に影響を与えられる方

 - エンジニアリング、サポート、マーケティングなどMapbox社内の各チームと連携し、案件の成約からお客様による製品・サービスの導入成功までを推進できる方

 - 強い探究心、相手の立場を理解する姿勢、そして困難な課題にも粘り強く取り組む力をお持ちの方。私たちはお客様とパートナーとして難しい課題の解決に取り組み、チームとして成功することを大切にしています。

 - 履歴書および応募書類は英語でご提出ください。




WHAT WE VALUE

このポジションに限らず、Mapboxのすべてのリーダーに共通して求められるコアバリュー https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/に加え、私たちは以下の考え方を大切にしています。

課題や新たな可能性に深く向き合い、高い成果を生み出す創造性豊かな人材を大切にしています。

一人ひとりが自分らしく働けることを大切にしています。そのために、充実したヘルスケア制度や育児休暇、ライフイベントに柔軟に対応できる働き方を整えるとともに、社員をより良くサポートするための仕組みを継続的に進化させています。

社員一人ひとりがそれぞれの役割で、そしてMapboxの一員として活躍するために必要な知識やスキルを身につけられるよう、互いに教え、学び合う環境を重視しています。

多様な人材が集まるチームを育てることには大きな価値があると考えています。バックグラウンド、性別、人種・民族、障がいの有無、性的指向などにかかわらず、あらゆる方からのご応募を歓迎します。

このポジションに応募することにより、Mapbox Privacy Policy https://www.mapbox.com/legal/privacyに同意したものとみなされます。

Mapboxは、公正かつ公平な採用プロセスの実現に取り組んでいます。法令で保護されるいかなる属性を理由とする差別も行いません。




SENIOR BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER, AUTOMOTIVE



Mapbox Japan is looking for talented people who want to help shape the future.

If you're passionate about maps, mobility, and location technology, we'd love to hear from you.

The automotive industry is undergoing a major transformation, driven by electrification, autonomous driving, and connected technologies. Through real-time maps, navigation experiences, and AI-powered vision, Mapbox works with leading OEMs around the world to shape the next generation of mobility.

As Senior Business Development Manager, Automotive, Japan, you will lead strategic partnerships with OEMs such as Toyota, Nissan, and Honda, as well as Tier 1 suppliers. You will work closely with these partners to shape new mobility experiences across navigation, ADAS, autonomous driving, AR, EV routing, and other emerging technologies.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Auto is undergoing a massive change towards electric and autonomous vehicles with a fully connected user experience - you’ve seen this in your work. At a time where these changes are actually reaching a tipping point, Mapbox delivers real-time updated maps, a polished user experience and AI vision enabling our OEM customers to build the future of mobility. We take a consultative, long-term partnership approach in developing business with our customers. We obsess with them about their drivers to create delightful experiences unique to their brand and we work with them to evolve in-car applications continuously throughout the lifetime of the vehicle.

As a Business Development Manager you’ll be responsible for the acquisition and management of some of the most valuable Japanese OEM accounts - Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others - many of whom we already work with. You will develop new opportunities around in-car navigation, augmented reality, ADAS and automated driving and manage our customer relationships from the first contact on. You’ll be the go-to person and senior advisor in everything related to location technology. You will develop term sheets for new projects and negotiate contracts that enable long-term account growth. You will engage partners in the automotive supplier space to position Mapbox for growth in the market. Location is a fundamental enabler of the future of mobility and the journey is just getting started. If you’re excited to build this future together with our customers, we’d love to hear from you.

 - Develop first of a kind opportunities with key accounts and advise customers on their location product strategy for navigation and automated driving products and lead complex proposal processes (RFI/RFQ/RFP) end to end

 - Build and foster connections with key senior decision makers, building lasting relationships between our partners and Mapbox

 - Shape and translate the Mapbox value proposition specifically for the Japan market

 - Combine Mapbox building blocks with deep customer knowledge to present compelling technical solutions with clear business outcomes, particularly around in-car navigation, mobile companion applications, automated driving, augmented reality and electric vehicle routing

 - Involve the Mapbox product leadership directly in the business development process to shape our technical roadmap

 


WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - Japanese and English proficiency required (verbal and written)

 - 10+ years of experience developing and negotiating complex deals involving a technical product

 - Consultative and solutions-oriented sales approach

 - Strong technical sales aptitude demonstrated through a combination of industry experience, size, and complexity of deals closed (you’ll be focused on seven and eight figure opportunities), and rapport with engineers and product owners

 - Ability to manage complex customer relationships, developing trust and influence with engineers & developers, and up to C-level leadership

 - Ability to collaborate across Mapbox teams including engineering, support, and marketing to close business and ensure successful customer launches

 - Deep curiosity, empathy, and grit — we’re partnering with our customers to solve hard problems, and we win as a team

 - Please submit your resume and application in English.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you agree to the Mapbox Privacy Policy https://www.mapbox.com/legal/privacy which is linked here.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

Mapbox is committed to providing a respectful, professional, and safe recruiting experience. All recruiting activities, including interviews and candidate communications, are strictly conducted through company-approved methods and channels.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer III, Routing Cost
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping.

Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. Mapbox has worked with automotive partners — including BMW, Toyota, and GM — to bring the best aspects of mobile app development into in-vehicle navigation and infotainment.

  • Mapbox Blog: Introducing 3D Live Navigation

  • Mapbox Blog: Route Notifications Improve Driver Safety

  • Mapbox Newsroom: AI Features in New Navigation SDK

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Machine Learning Engineer III on the Routing Cost team, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly trafficked recommendation systems for our routing cost engine. Your technical contributions will include:

  • Lead the engineering team(s) to execute end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation organization (~80 engineers).

  • Design and build new ML and data pipelines, as well as optimizing existing ML and data pipelines.

  • Build tools for automated quality assurance and data exploration.

  • Leverage geospatial algorithms to optimize pipelines, as well as creating automated tuning and outlier detection algorithms.

  • Partner with data scientists to make improvements to our models for determining patterns in movement and/or traffic.

  • Mentor colleagues and participate in code and design reviews.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of backend and ML experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the engineering field. Experience with Reinforcement Learning.

  • Technical knowledge: Extensive experience with Python, distributed processing pipelines (Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Dask), and very large datasets – statistical analysis, data quality control, optimizing storage.

  • Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud and infrastructure services, including, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud environments.

  • Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team.

  • Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine.

  • Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.

  • Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them.

  • Mentorship: Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams developing skill sets and career growth.

  • Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience. You are able to lead and resolve org-wide technical discussions and are able to collaborate and include input from cross-functional teams (security, devops, data, compliance and product).

  • Data informed mindset: You believe in the value of data informed decision making and strive to measure things that are not straight forward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data.

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 hr per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. 

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

  • You will analyze, fix and enrich large volumes of data (e.g. up to several tens of roads kilometers per week);

  • Ability to stay focused on a repetitive work during a working day, keeping high quality and accuracy of data processing;

  • Presence of logic, ability to reason and act independently;

  • Analytical mindset and ability to identify common patterns in large volumes of information;

  • Resistant to stress in a rapidly changing situation;

  • A quick learner, ability to switch between projects with different workflow or instructions, multi-tasking;

  • Ability to work in a team and high communicative skills;

  • Ability to work from the office for the first three months during the probation period, visit the office for team sprints periodically.

Welcomed

  • General knowledge of traffic rules for qualitative analysis of traffic situations and modeling driver behavior or use-cases (ideally, driving license or completed driving school);

  • Understanding OpenStreetMap service and an interest in cartography (if you have an account with OSM edits, please, specify in your CV);

  • Experience working in GIS, cartography or geodesy;

  • Experience working in IT-sphere or completed IT-courses for understanding communication culture and processes in high-technology international company;

  • Interest in developing their skills and expanding their competencies within the working domain.

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel - Product/Commercial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What You'll Do

We’re looking for a lawyer with 7 + years of practicing attorney experience to join our small and collaborative legal team. The right candidate will have worked at a technology company, be technically savvy and hard-working, keen to learn our products and business, and willing to dig into a wide variety of projects in a fast-paced environment. On the commercial side, this encompasses complex data in-licenses, as well as customer sales and automotive OEM deals. Most of our commercial deals involve substantial work with our product and engineering colleagues, so there is a product-counseling aspect to this position as well.

This is a senior individual contributor role where you will come up with practical and creative solutions to get complex deals done and advance our business. Drafting and communication skills are extremely important. We believe that it is the role of in-house counsel to own the deal. You will develop the ability to both mitigate and accept risk. We almost never say to our colleagues “that’s a business issue for you to decide.”

Mapbox’s customers use our SDKs and APIs to build their own location-aware applications. Our products are building blocks that our customers can use in various different ways, so our sales agreements are technically more complex than in an enterprise software or SaaS software company. We don’t believe that lawyers can give good legal advice in a vacuum, so you must be able to become very conversant with and draft agreements based on our specific customers’ use case and technical implementations. We are not processing hundreds of small sales deals with tweaks to the governing law clause. Instead, our data in-licenses and sales/OEM deals are complex and require a thoughtful approach by a senior lawyer. While we work closely together and thus teach and learn from each other every day, you will not have direct reports.

We think it’s important to continually be improving operational processes/updating forms because this is how we can scale a small legal organization, supporting a fast-growing tech company. You need to share and participate in these efforts to scale our department and improve our services. Prior work in a pre-IPO company will be extremely helpful.

We are a flat organization, but we pitch in and help each other. You must be willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into a variety of legal issues, enjoy the give and take of collaboration and take feedback.

The breadth, variety and complexity of projects that you will handle at Mapbox is great training for cross-functional generalists who want to better understand and practically address business problems and risk.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  7+ years of practicing attorney experience, with 2+ years at a top-tier law firm in any area and 5+ years in-house at a technology company in sales-side commercial transactions (not procurement or privacy/regulatory compliance).

  • At least one of the following is required:

    1. Computer engineering, computer science or other similar technical degree.

    2. At least 2, but not more than 4, years experience in software patent litigation or patent prosecution at a top tier firm.

    3. Extensive experience working with APIs and SDKs.

  • Experience working on complex sales deals.

  • Excellent communication skills. Your writing and verbal communications need to be clear and concise.

  • A practical and customer-centric orientation and negotiation style. You understand (or will quickly learn) the business deal so you know what matters and what doesn't and will focus on practical resolutions to speed deals through the pipeline.

  • A sense of humor. We take our work seriously, but we try not to take ourselves too seriously.

  • The legal team is working entirely remotely. While we think candidates who live near technology hubs often have the best backgrounds, we will consider remote candidates who live anywhere in the US. We prefer candidates in the Pacific time zone.

  • JD degree from top-tier law school and active membership in at least one US state bar.

  • If your resume doesn’t clearly demonstrate the first two points above, you should include a cover note as to why you are interested in this role and why you think you would be a good fit despite not meeting those criteria. Resumes without a cover note in those circumstances will likely not be considered.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How We Support You

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Private medical coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Fertility & Family Building: Inclusive fertility support. Grow your family on your terms.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth.

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Flexible paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

  • Invest & Grow: Retirement plans with competitive matching.

 

Our total annual cash compensation for this role ranges from $240,000 - $330,000. Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you agree to the Mapbox Privacy Policy which is linked here.

Mapbox participates in E-Verify to confirm employee work authorization. Please refer to the Notice of E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters for more information.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

We are not processing hundreds of small sales deals with tweaks to the governing law clause. Instead, our data in-licenses and sales/OEM deals are complex and require a thoughtful approach by a senior lawyer. While we work closely together and thus teach and learn from each other every day, you will not have direct reports.

We think it’s important to continually be improving operational processes/updating forms because this is how we can scale a small legal organization, supporting a fast-growing tech company. You need to share and participate in these efforts to scale our department and improve our services. Prior work in a pre-IPO company will be extremely helpful.

We are a flat organization, but we pitch in and help each other. You must be willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into a variety of legal issues, enjoy the give and take of collaboration and take feedback.

The breadth, variety and complexity of projects that you will handle at Mapbox is great training for cross-functional generalists who want to better understand and practically address business problems and risk.




WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 -  7+ years of practicing attorney experience, with 2+ years at a top-tier law firm in any area and 5+ years in-house at a technology company in sales-side commercial transactions (not procurement or privacy/regulatory compliance).

 - At least one of the following is required:
   
   1. Computer engineering, computer science or other similar technical degree.
   
   2. At least 2, but not more than 4, years experience in software patent litigation or patent prosecution at a top tier firm.
   
   3. Extensive experience working with APIs and SDKs.

 - Experience working on complex sales deals.

 - Excellent communication skills. Your writing and verbal communications need to be clear and concise.

 - A practical and customer-centric orientation and negotiation style. You understand (or will quickly learn) the business deal so you know what matters and what doesn't and will focus on practical resolutions to speed deals through the pipeline.

 - A sense of humor. We take our work seriously, but we try not to take ourselves too seriously.

 - The legal team is working entirely remotely.  While we think candidates who live near technology hubs often have the best backgrounds, we will consider remote candidates who live anywhere in the US. We prefer candidates in the Pacific time zone.

 - JD degree from top-tier law school and active membership in at least one US state bar.

 - If your resume doesn’t clearly demonstrate the first two points above, you should include a cover note as to why you are interested in this role and why you think you would be a good fit despite not meeting those criteria.  Resumes without a cover note in those circumstances will likely not be considered.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

HOW WE SUPPORT YOU

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, Logistics API
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

Our team is responsible for the Directions and Logistics APIs, which power everything from a single driver's route request to the complex logistics optimization for major delivery companies. We handle millions of requests daily, operating under strict latency requirements, making our work both challenging and highly rewarding. Given the essential nature of our services, we maintain a responsible on-call rotation and treat alarms seriously to ensure system stability without excessive noise.
We have an exciting roadmap for 2026, and this is the perfect time to join us to be a part of this exciting journey!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include a discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and operating significant areas of our routing services. In this role, you can expect to:

  • Design and implement scalable services for our API and routing engine tiers, following best practices for deployment, resilience, and observability.

  • Design and improve services that power the data consumption and storage of the routing data.

  • Drive the design, development, and testing of Mapbox tools

  • Shape internal tools and automations to make the whole engineering life easier and fun.

  • Drive design and development of services quality metrics and analytics.

  • Run and design experiments to evaluate the quality, reliability, and capacity requirements of our user-facing navigation products.

  • Participate in end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation team; review code and design documents, shepherd feature releases, and participate in an on-call rotation.

  • Work with product owners, sales engineering, and management to drive future product direction.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 12/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

Navigation API services interact with many internal systems at Mapbox, making this a high-visibility team with great opportunities to collaborate across the company.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering web services in either Rust or Typescript (Node.js)

  • Experience building highly-available API services within container-based environments (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, etc. on AWS)

  • Proficiency in implementing monitoring instrumentation, triaging incidents, resolving customer issues, and continuous product improvement

  • Knowledge of operating systems and distributed systems (e.g., fault-tolerance, consistency, service discovery, etc.)

  • Proven ability to design long-term technical strategies that balance immediate product delivery with the reduction of systemic technical debt across multiple departments

  • Extensive experience driving high-visibility initiatives that improve engineering standards and operational excellence for the cross-functional teams

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills (B2 level minimum). Mapbox has offices across the globe. You should communicate about complex ideas concisely to an audience worldwide

  • Experience or interest in solving geo-spatial problems

Candidates should also have:

  • A desire to work with individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences

  • Enthusiasm for learning and knowledge sharing in a multidisciplinary environment, supported by mentorship experience and strong written and verbal communication skills

  • A rigorous approach to problem solving, using experiments and data analysis to drive quality of service improvements

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How We Support You

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What You'll Do

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

  • Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

  • Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

  • Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

  • Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

  • Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  •  5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

  • Native-level Mandarin and English fluency: Exemplary written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

  • Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

  • Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

  • Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

  • Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

  • Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

  • Strong business acumen and comfort working autonomously across distributed teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex requirements into scalable, robust architectures aligned with customer objectives.

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive audiences, combined with a proven ability to influence executive, product, engineering, and developer stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting high volumes of customer opportunities and context-switching efficiently across stakeholders.

  • Experience in various industries (e.g. logistics, telecom, weather) is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, workshops, and industry events.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

At Mapbox, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) ensure successful, on-time launches for Mapbox's key customers by turning complex needs into realized value. TPMs independently develop and execute strategies to maximize customer satisfaction, while minimizing thrash in changes to priorities and roadmap. They provide high-judgement updates to Mapbox leaders–keeping them informed on progress while handling the day-to-day operations independently.

 

What You'll Do

Mapbox is seeking a Technical Program Manager III (TPM) to lead complex, high-visibility post-sales programs for our large automotive customers. This is a high-impact role in a dynamic environment where you will work both independently and collaboratively alongside a high-performing team of TPMs to deliver successful customer launches. You will drive operational rigor within your programs, acting as a key driver of accountability and consistent, high-quality delivery across cross-functional teams within Mapbox.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex automotive customer launches and programs, serving as the main point of contact for program health, timelines, and execution

  • Be the primary interface between our key automotive customers and our internal teams, advocating for mutual success by championing the needs of our customers with internal teams (including leadership, product management, engineering, sales, technical support), and representing Mapbox to our customers

  • Define success for our customer programs, including how we measure it, and how we get there.

  • Align with Product and Engineering to translate and prioritize customer feedback into actionable insights and roadmap clarity.

  • Set and uphold a high quality bar, working with technical support, product and engineering teams to ensure effective prioritization and resolution of quality issues, and to synthesize and address overarching quality concerns.

  • Lead senior-level discussions - both internally and externally - around delivery timelines, trade-offs, scope, and business impact.

  • Provide calm and decisive program leadership during high-pressure situations with customers.

  • Provide clear & concise reporting to program key stakeholders and track and manage and report on program risks, working with customers and internal teams to mitigate and/or and escalate for resolution.

  • Lead or contribute to internal initiatives to improve internal processes across the TPM and Mapbox organizations.

  • Develop a deep knowledge of Mapbox products and services in order to steer technical discussions and build trust with our customers

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise software implementations in a highly regulated post-sales or professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated success in the automotive industry managing scope, SOW execution, change management, and high-impact customer escalations.

  • Proven ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments from kickoff through production launch.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 20%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Delivery-Oriented Leader: You are accountable for outcomes and not just coordination. You build structure in ambiguity and create operational discipline that enables predictable success.

  • Customer-Centric Operator: You proactively represent the customer internally and ensure their business objectives drive implementation priorities.

  • Effective Communicator: You engage effectively across audiences from developers to senior executives with clarity, confidence, and precision.

  • Technically Fluent: You understand cloud architectures, API/SDK integrations, and enterprise technical ecosystems deeply enough to anticipate risk and guide execution credibly.

  • Cross-Functional Influencer: You navigate matrixed organizations effectively aligning Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Executive Leadership to deliver customer outcomes.

  • Knowledge of Automotive SPICE is desirable

Core Working Hours

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

  • Standby / On-Call: As needed with ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 30%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Mapbox 은 미래를 바꾸는 동료를 찾고 있습니다.

지도·모빌리티·위치 테크놀로지에 두근두근하는 분, 꼭 봐 주세요!

솔루션 아키텍트로서 글로벌 OEM에서 국내 스타트 업까지

폭넓은 고객과 함께 차세대 이동 체험을 디자인해 나가는 포지션입니다.

What You'll Do

Solutions Architects are trusted technical and business advisors who partner with customers to design, prototype, and deliver solutions on the Mapbox platform. You will work directly with customers and account teams to discover needs, design architectures, and deliver solutions that turn data, mobility, and mapping into effective digital experiences and measurable business outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth with commercial acumen and thrives at the intersection of strategy, architecture, and delivery. Successful candidates typically have a mix of software engineering, product management, solutions engineering, and technical consulting experience prior to this role.

Core responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to position Mapbox’s technical value and shape opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer goals, requirements, and success criteria, and ensure solution designs meet business objectives.

  • Design and present scalable architectures using Mapbox SDKs, APIs, and platform services.

  • Respond to technical customer requests (RFI/RFQ) with clear technical documentation and solution proposals.

  • Provide technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle and deliver rapid technical enablement via workshops, demos, and PoC/PoV in a fast-paced digital customer environment.

  • Drive customer success by accelerating time-to-value and supporting adoption and expansion in a dynamic, complex ecosystem.

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide structured feedback to influence product and engineering direction.

  • Stay current on mapping, mobility, and AI technologies and share best practices internally and with customers.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years in solutions architecture, customer-facing engineering (pre-sales, post-sales), or consulting.

  • Fluent in Korean and English (both written and verbal communication)

  • Location: Must reside in Japan or South Korea

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies (JavaScript, Android, iOS).

  • Experience building applications that integrate back-end APIs and front-end SDKs.

  • Experience of GIS, location intelligence, geospatial data, and mapping is a plus.

  • Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

  • Experience with AI technologies is a plus.

  • Experience leading technical responses for RFI/RFQ, crafting comprehensive technical proposals.

  • Strong business acumen and comfort working autonomously across distributed teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex requirements into scalable, robust architectures aligned with customer objectives.

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive audiences, combined with a proven ability to influence executive, product, engineering, and developer stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.

  • Understanding of the Automotive industry and its ecosystem technologies such as navigation, autonomous driving, ADAS, ISA, and software-defined vehicles.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, workshops, and industry events

  • Please submit your resume and application in English.

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.
